purpose: Owner decisions answering review records that returned substantive_owner_decision_required. A disposition states what the owner decided; it does not itself change any family's inputs, and it names what has to happen for the decision to take effect.

answering.question: AOC-CR-296 is the district attorney's petition — its printed face names the DA as filer and its party block reads 'Name And Address Of Defendant' — and it is carried as participant_completed and participantFillable. Does it belong in a participant packet at all?

decision.pathwaySellable: only where supported participant-filed documents independently justify a paid packet

whatThisMeans: AOC-CR-296 is not delivered as a participant artifact. It is not filled, not rendered into a participant packet, and not presented as something the participant completes or files.
No checkout, entitlement or packet-completion gate may require this form to be completed. A pathway that would only be sellable because this form is counted is not sellable.
The form may be NAMED to the participant as a step that a prosecutor controls, so the participant understands what has to happen and who has to do it.
The participant receives clear guidance explaining that the district attorney files this petition, and what the participant can do to ask the district attorney to bring it.
The underlying North Carolina pathway remains sellable only where participant-filed documents that ARE supported independently justify the paid packet on their own.
dispositions.notMarkedPlatformReady: This disposition does not make AOC-CR-296 platform-ready as a participant artifact, and must not be read as an approval. It answers the ownership question and nothing else.

toTakeEffect.note: This record changes no family input. Applying the decision means editing the family's own source-record.json (documentOwnership, participantFillable, generationAllowed) and re-deriving the package, which changes that family's hashes and is therefore a rerender.
requiredChanges: source-record.json: documentOwnership -> prosecutor_controlled; participantFillable -> false; participantCompleted -> false
re-derive the field map and classification so no participant fact binds
remove AOC-CR-296 from any participant packet manifest and from any checkout dependency
author the participant guidance text that names the DA as the filer
toTakeEffect.notDoneInThisWave: The correction wave was scoped to three rerender families — KY AOC-334, KY AOC-496.3 and NC AOC-CR-288 — and CR-296 is not one of them. Its inputs are left byte-for-byte unchanged so no unrelated family hash moves.
